tasks.contract: stop_after_attempt must fire once the attempt number reaches the max so the final attempt ends the cycle; requiring strictly more runs every schedule one attempt long across the attempt-stop-end chain.
tasks.body:
from tenacity import RetryCallState, Retrying
from tenacity.stop import stop_after_attempt
stop=stop_after_attempt(3)
ctl=Retrying()
state=RetryCallState(ctl,None,(),{})
decisions=[]
for attempt in (1,2,3,4):
    state.attempt_number=attempt
    decisions.append(stop(state))
print('stop_call_sequence',decisions)
assert decisions==[False,False,True,True]

tasks.contract: The never-retry gate must reject every outcome so nothing retries; gating on a positive attempt number retries every cycle across the outcome-decision chain.

tasks.contract: Jittered waits must add the jitter to the exponential and clamp into range; subtracting and clamping outside collapses every sleep to zero across the attempt-sleep-end chain.
tasks.body:
import random
from tenacity import RetryCallState, Retrying
from tenacity.wait import wait_exponential_jitter
random.seed(7)
strat=wait_exponential_jitter()
state=RetryCallState(Retrying(),None,(),{})
values=[]
for attempt in (1,2,3):
    state.attempt_number=attempt
    values.append(strat(state))
print('jitter_call_sequence',values)
assert values==[1.3238327648331625, 2.150849173924502, 4.650934473039854]

tasks.contract: Outcome construction must wrap results as results and exceptions as exceptions so downstream predicates inspect the right branch; swapping the branches and returning None breaks the produce-inspect-decide chain.
tasks.body:
from tenacity import Future
ok=Future.construct(1, 'v', False)
err=Future.construct(1, ValueError('x'), True)
events=[ok.result(), ok.failed, err.failed, type(err.exception()).__name__]
print('future_construct_sequence',events)
assert events==['v', False, True, 'ValueError']

tasks.contract: stop_all must require every sub-stop so the latest deadline governs; using any ends at the earliest deadline across the attempt-stop-end chain.
tasks.body:
from tenacity import RetryCallState, Retrying
from tenacity.stop import stop_all, stop_after_attempt
combined=stop_all(stop_after_attempt(2), stop_after_attempt(5))
ctl=Retrying()
state=RetryCallState(ctl,None,(),{})
decisions=[]
for attempt in (1,2,3,5,6):
    state.attempt_number=attempt
    decisions.append(combined(state))
print('stop_all_call_sequence',decisions)
assert decisions==[False,False,False,True,True]

tasks.contract: waitnoecho must report true once echo clears and false on timeout expiry; inverting both outcomes breaks the spawn-poll-detect chain for password prompts.
tasks.body:
from ptyprocess import PtyProcess
proc=PtyProcess.spawn(['sleep','5'])
try:
    proc.setecho(False)
    first=proc.waitnoecho(timeout=5)
    proc.setecho(True)
    second=proc.waitnoecho(timeout=1)
    proc.setecho(False)
    third=proc.waitnoecho(timeout=5)
    print('waitnoecho_invert_sequence',[first,second,third])
    assert [first,second,third]==[True,False,True]
finally:
    try: proc.terminate(force=True)
    except Exception: pass
    try: proc.wait()
    except Exception: pass
    try: proc.close()
    except Exception: pass

tasks.contract: Reading the echo flag must report the actual terminal state after each set call; returning the inverted flag from the wrong bit breaks the set-poll-detect chain.
tasks.body:
from ptyprocess import PtyProcess
proc=PtyProcess.spawn(['sleep','5'])
try:
    proc.setecho(True)
    on_state=proc.getecho()
    proc.setecho(False)
    off_state=proc.getecho()
    waited=proc.waitnoecho(timeout=5)
    print('getecho_roundtrip_sequence',[on_state,off_state,waited])
    assert [on_state,off_state,waited]==[True,False,True]
finally:
    try: proc.terminate(force=True)
    except Exception: pass
    try: proc.wait()
    except Exception: pass
    try: proc.close()
    except Exception: pass

tasks.contract: Bulk update must build and execute the update statement for every full chunk and the tail; deleting the statement leaves rows unpersisted across the produce-execute-read chain.
tasks.body:
from dataset import Database
db=Database('sqlite:///:memory:')
t=db['t']
t.insert({'id':1,'v':'a'})
t.insert({'id':2,'v':'b'})
t.insert({'id':3,'v':'c'})
t.update_many([{'id':1,'v':'a1'},{'id':2,'v':'b1'},{'id':3,'v':'c1'}], ['id'])
rows=sorted([(r['id'],r['v']) for r in t.all()])
print('bulk_update_sequence',rows)
assert rows==[(1,'a1'),(2,'b1'),(3,'c1')]

tasks.contract: Conditional insert must persist a missing row and skip an existing one by key; always returning false without inserting loses the check-persist-read chain.
tasks.body:
from dataset import Database
db=Database('sqlite:///:memory:')
t=db['t']
t.insert({'id':1,'v':'a'})
dup=t.insert_ignore({'id':1,'v':'b'}, ['id'])
count_dup=t.count()
val=[r['v'] for r in t.all()][0]
fresh=t.insert_ignore({'id':2,'v':'c'}, ['id'])
count_fresh=t.count()
print('insert_ignore_sequence',[dup,count_dup,bool(fresh),count_fresh,val])
assert [dup,count_dup,bool(fresh),count_fresh,val]==[False,1,True,2,'a']
